description: Searches the free browser games listed on Foundplay, made by independent creators, many with AI tools. Use it for any request for browser games to play: by genre or kind, on a phone, with friends, made with AI, or new this week. Examples: {"query": "zombie"}; {"genre": "racing", "phone": true}; {"aiMade": true, "sort": "new"}. Matches the query against titles, one-line descriptions and genres; a game whose title, main genre or tag has a query word comes first. English words in the query for a phone, friends, made with AI or new turn on those filters and that order (see intent). Returns catalog device and multiplayer facts, counted outbound clicks, upvotes, creator credit and Foundplay page links. Read-only. Defaults to most played; best uses the website's quality ranking, with its method and limits, not a review. aiMade requires recorded AI-creation provenance. The query may be in Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian or Indonesian; with lang, pitches and links are in that language where translated.

aiMade.description: true requires recorded evidence of AI-assisted creation, using the website's AI-made list rules. False or omitted does not filter by AI use; missing evidence is unknown.

lang.description: The language the person is asking in: es (Spanish), pt (Portuguese), de (German), fr (French), it (Italian), id (Indonesian) or vi (Vietnamese). The query is read in that language, and each pitch and page link is in it where Foundplay has a translation, else English. en keeps the query English. Omitted, a query plainly in one of the seven is read in it.

limit.description: How many games to return. Default 8.

multiplayer.description: true for catalog multiplayer support, online or on one screen. Does not guarantee online play or a particular player count.

phone.description: true for catalog phone support, such as touch controls. Not a physical-device test or a guarantee for every iPhone, Android device or browser.

query.description: Words required in the title, description or genre, such as 'zombie shooter' or 'cozy farm'. The phone, multiplayer, aiMade and sort inputs are the exact way to ask for those; in English, words such as 'phone', '2 player', 'made with AI' and 'new' in the query also turn them on, and filler such as 'free', 'online' and 'games' is dropped. Leave empty or omit for broad discovery with filters.

sort.description: popular (all-time counted clicks, the default), trending (last 48 hours), new (newest Foundplay listings, not original release dates), or best (the website's quality ranking of eligible originals).

name: search_games

aiMadeFilter.description: Present when aiMade is true or the query's words asked for AI-made games, including when no games match.

canonicalUrl.description: AI-made reference list, narrowed to the AI-phone list when phone is also true. Other request constraints are not applied to this reference page.

apiSearch.description: Public JSON search self-link retaining text, sort, limit, genre, phone, multiplayer, AI-made filters and the language. Public assistant eligibility applies; no owner authorization is included.

browseAll.description: Broader website Browse destination preserving only its supported filters. See browseAllMeaning; it is not the same eligible result set.

browseAllMeaning.description: Which request choices the broader website Browse link preserves and which it does not.

aiMadeEvidence.description: Present only for aiMade:true. The recorded signal and public source, not proof of a specific AI workflow or a code audit.

sourceUrl.description: Public context for the recorded signal, not an independent code verification. Jam and host pages may not name every matched game.

canonicalUrl.description: The same game page without attribution parameters: the address to cite.

listedAt.description: When this listing was added to Foundplay, in ISO 8601 UTC. Not the game's original release date or a gameplay/device test date.

multiplayer.description: Catalog flag: true for multiplayer, false for single-player, null if unknown. Multiplayer can be online or on one screen; this does not specify a player count.

pageLanguage.description: Present when the search was read in another language: the language of the linked Foundplay page. Not the language of the game itself.

phoneFriendly.description: Catalog flag: true for phone support, false for keyboard/computer, null if unknown. Not a physical-device test or a guarantee for every phone or browser.

pitchLanguage.description: Present when the search was read in another language: the language the pitch is in. en when Foundplay has no translation of the current pitch.

plays.description: All-time counted outbound Play clicks, including when sort is trending. Not confirmed gameplay or unique people. See playsMeaning.

qualityTier.description: Present for best order: the catalog's signal-based tier, not a review rating.

url.description: The game's page on Foundplay, with a Play button.

intent.description: Present when English words in the query asked for a filter or a sort, or were filler. A query that is a listed game's whole title is kept as typed and has no intent block.

excludeMultiplayer.description: Present only when the query asks for recorded single-player games, excluding true and unknown multiplayer values.

read.description: The phrases read as filters, sorts or filler.

words.description: The words still required in each game's title, description or genres.

language.description: Present when the query was read in Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian or Indonesian, including when no games match.

detected.description: true when the language came from the query's own words, false when lang was sent.

understoodAs.description: How the query was read: the English words searched for, and the filters its words asked for.

excludeMultiplayer.description: Present only for a query-derived single-player exclusion.

listsMeaning.description: Related lists and technology collections are broader reading; their contents do not apply the requested game filters or assistant-safety constraints. Technology membership does not establish AI creation, device support or runtime compatibility.

phoneFilter.description: Present when phone is true or the query's words asked for phone games, including empty results. Describes recorded support and its limits.

canonicalUrl.description: The general phone-games reference list; other request constraints are not applied to this page.

playsMeaning.description: How the public play count is measured and what it does not establish.

ranking.description: Present for best order, including when no eligible game matches.

singlePlayerFilter.description: Present only when the query asks to exclude multiplayer, including empty or contradictory results.

conflict.description: True when another query phrase or the explicit multiplayer input also requires multiplayer; no game satisfies both.

total.description: How many games matched in all.

title: Search browser games
